text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: That's amazing, you worked so hard!
You're amazing, you did so well!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see. I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We really won...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *hic*.
...Waaaaahhhh!!
Bathed in thunderous cheers, I celebrated the victory alongside a sobbing Special Week...
And—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*......... *sigh*.
My eyes are definitely going to be swollen tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm making a terrible face,
could you please not laugh too much...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
You're so kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, huh...? A phone call?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...! It's from Mom!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello!?
Yeah... yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
......I see.
You were watching my Derby.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah. That makes sense.
Together with the picture of birth-mom, too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Mom, how did I do?
I... I really did it!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've gotten just a wee bit more respectable, ain't I?

How her mother answered...
Even without asking, the look on her face told the whole story.
And after the phone call, I walked the thoroughly exhausted girl back to her dorm, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
If you'd like, would you want to grab something to eat after this?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, that's part of it, too.
But today, there's one more thing—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: To celebrate you becoming a "Derby Trainer", Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's order whatever we like together
and eat until we're stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Even I'm not
just a glutton, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How was I... today?
choice_data_list: She was an Uma Musume I could be proud of.
She was an Uma Musume I could be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I'm happy, so very happy.

Special Week narrowed her sparkling eyes
and smiled happily...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Alright! I'll eat tons of tasty food and give it my all again tomorrow~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Let's go, Trainer!!
